Harper: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: cloud-control plane in ap-southeast had intermittent auth 5xx that cascaded into model-registry write failures and a small spike in inference errors. Need owners for immediate fixes + a 4-week recurrence check.
Zoe: Saw the spike 05:22-05:30 UTC. Our metadata reconciler was doing a full sweep and retried aggressively on 5xx; that amplified the vendor throttle. I'll take the reconciler changes: async flush + concurrency cap. ETA: PR by Tue.
Mateo: Ill own client resilience for the auth path: token cache with optimistic refresh, staggered issuance jitter, and a circuit-breaker that trips on repeated 5xxs. ETA: Thu EOD.
Ishaan: I'll add alerting + a vendor-pulse calendar entry: alert if registry_write_success < 95% for 5m and auth_exchange_errors > 1% for 5m. Will attach runbook and vendor incident link. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Harper: Good. Also prototype an automatic fallback: if write failures >=3 within 120s, route inference to last-known-good read-only snapshot for up to 15m. Need product signoff for perf/cost; I'll loop in product.
Mateo: For quick wins I'll add full jitter + per-request retry cap and a small smoke test to CI that simulates provider 5xx. Example I'll add:
```
# simulate provider 5xx storm
python tools/simulate_provider_5xx.py --duration 60 --rate 0.6
```
Zoe: Reconciler snippet: change to incremental async flush, limit to 8 workers, and backoff on 429/5xx. I'll include bench notes.
alerts-bot: Created ticket: [AUTH-862] "Token cache + jitter + circuit-breaker" assigned to Mateo (due 2026-04-10). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-862
alerts-bot: Created ticket: [REG-879] "Reconciler async flush + concurrency cap" assigned to Zoe (due 2026-04-07). https://jira.redwood/REG-879
alerts-bot: Created ticket: [OPS-309] "Compound alert + vendor pulse" assigned to Ishaan (due 2026-03-31). https://jira.redwood/OPS-309
Harper: Action summary I'll paste into the postmortem doc:
- Mateo: AUTH-862 PR + CI smoke by Thu
- Zoe: REG-879 impl + bench notes by Tue
- Ishaan: OPS-309 alerts + runbook + calendar by tomorrow AM
- Harper: product ask + fallback prototype by next Wed
Mateo: I'll attach jitter math and a short client patch to AUTH-862.
Zoe: I'll include a small canary that exercises token path in the eu region and a dashboard panel for retry-amplification.
Ishaan: Scheduling the 15m weekly pulse for 4 weeks starting 2026-03-30. Invite sent.
Harper: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If any regression appears escalate to #incidents and ping me directly.
Mateo: :white_check_mark:
